stages.desc: How much practical help the so-called "Mutual Aid Society" provided to the islanders' lives, no one knows. But even just having a place where one could safely pour out some grievances was already a tremendous help to the islanders.

“我听说赠送羽毛是黎博利表示好意的方式，可我没有羽毛，只能把自己的头发编成绳结，送给镇上的每一个孩子。那时候，我真的很期望他们谁能回赠我一顶帽子，好让我的头皮不被海风吹得生疼。”

“父亲不愿让我把他的骨灰撒入大海，尽管他曾亲口说过那是阿戈尔人的传统。他恨这片土地，但他终归在这里挣扎了太久，不愿就这么轻描淡写地‘离开’。哪怕只是一抔骨灰，他也算是在这里留下了点什么。”

stages.desc: People suddenly realized that at least for this moment, they could celebrate to their hearts' content and leave every worry for tomorrow. Only because they had finally become certain that they truly had a tomorrow.

stages.name: Moonsurge
stages.desc: Simply by existing, it pulls on everything on the earth. That force is faint and distant, yet beyond doubt.

stages.name: Lunar Halo
stages.desc: You can't come to Laterano without trying out firearms—not to learn them, but to understand that you can't. That's the kind of place Laterano is.

stages.name: Moonshift
stages.desc: Countless imperceptible factors are changing its trajectory, and some of the reasons lie right before your eyes.

stages.name: Moonslant
stages.desc: It does not rise at night and set by day, and its westward slant does not mean dawn is near.

stages.name: Lunar Eclipse
stages.desc: What obscures it is your own shadow.

stages.name: Moonhang
stages.desc: It often appears when you think it isn't there, and vice versa.

stages.name: Full Moon
stages.desc: Laterano, lift your head. What is that reflected in your eyes?

stages.name: Foundation of Desire
stages.desc: I want rest. I want peace. I don't want to worry, and I don't want to suffer like this. Don't we deserve tranquility?

stages.name: Pillar of Seclusion
stages.desc: I'm only thinking about it. I won't hurt anyone, and no one will hurt me. It's safe.

stages.name: Wall of Denial
stages.desc: Leaving or staying—neither is right. But can you tell me what is right? You can't. Not even the Pope can.

stages.name: Hall of Rumination
stages.desc: No, I've already thought it through.

stages.name: Corridor of Rigidity
stages.desc: I only moved a little. Did I bother you?

stages.name: Beam of Dissociation
stages.desc: Really? I did something like that? Haha, if you hadn't brought it up, I wouldn't have even remembered.

stages.name: Arch of Agitation
stages.desc: I've gone over tomorrow's schedule a hundred times, minute by minute. It feels like there are ten thousand ways it could go wrong... Am I overthinking this?

stages.name: Summit of Nihility
stages.desc: Thankfully, all of this is about to end.

stages.name: Moonset
stages.desc: Through ten layers of cloud and ten layers of rain, ten layers of clear sky and a thousand bolts of lightning, the moon fell into the water, and ripples stirred faintly.

stages.name: A Full-Moon Life
stages.desc: All things have a beginning and an end. In between, we live in our own way.

stages.name: Moonshadow
stages.desc: In the murmuring depths of night, moonlight casts the shadows of all things.

Rustle, rustle. It's the sound of wind-blown sand pelting the car window—and the sound of something secretly rummaging through your backpack.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Sunrise in the Valley
stages.desc:
What has blocked out Rim Billiton's harsh sunlight? What has brought shade to the unsheltered mines? The sturdy Cautus miners of Sun Valley Industries!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Brave Short-Ears
stages.desc:
The one who dazzled the dark underground in memory reappears more than a decade later.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Honesty Is Hardest
stages.desc:
A strange sound from the broadcast of a deserted ghost town—the 'Guide' who led the Infected in pursuit of happiness is none other than—?
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: The Weight of Lies
stages.desc:
What is friendship made of? It is promises, resolve, the courage to say no, and footsteps that always run toward each other.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Resolve as the Postmark
stages.desc:
Transform the weight of regret, reshape the speed at which disappointment sinks, and let the ending change before it hits the ground.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Drawing Our Dawn
stages.desc:
This is the end of the journey, this is the edge of the earth, and this is the answer the four of them gave themselves.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>
Ranged Operators can be deployed on Melee tiles in this stage.

stages.name: Movie Addiction Prevention
stages.desc:
A few thoroughly worn-out residents have asked you to teach their kids a lesson. Ever since they got hooked on Siracusan gangster movies, the kids have become completely lawless!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Parcel Assembly Line
stages.desc:
How about experiencing a day in the life of a messenger sorting all kinds of cargo?
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Underground Hide-and-Seek
stages.desc:
Hide-and-seek, a game almost every Cautus played as a child: hide in the tangled rabbit holes underground, then block the conspicuous exits with something, heh heh... Wait, why can't I get out?
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Tufts Everywhere
stages.desc:
Letters, parcels, ordinary daily goods—even the dried carrot snack you just picked up and haven't gotten into your mouth yet—the Marsupial Musbeasts want it all!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: 'Lebyang Shuhun'
stages.desc:
Take a bite—actually, nothing happens. You'll just choke on it and sneeze!
Ranged Operators can be deployed on Melee tiles in this stage.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Messenger? Caster!
stages.desc:
The girl who was just handing you letters with a sunny smile might, in the next second, become a powerful Caster who uses Originium Arts to send parcel thieves flying into the air.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>
In this operation, Messenger Angelina is strengthened even more once the Mailbox is filled

stages.name: Three Cautus Burrows
stages.desc:
A hundred Pitas, a hundred Barnetts, and a hundred Melas can pop out of the rabbit hole!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: An Encounter with Marsupial Musbeasts
stages.desc:
Squeak squeak squeak, quack quack quack, squeak squeak squeak quack! (The sun is shining and the breeze is gentle today. I've got a whole pouch full of treasures, and I'm off to grab some new ones!)
Ranged Operators can be deployed on Melee tiles in this stage.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: The Great Springs Town Feast
stages.desc:
Long-eared Cautus or short-eared Cautus, feathered, horned, or scaled—so long as you come here and love ice cream, carrots, and hot springs, you're a guest of the Great Springs Town!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Mailbox Defense
stages.desc:
If a communications tower can be used to dry carrots, can't a mailbox work as a little granary?—Hey, don't just stuff random things in there!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: A New Way Through
stages.desc:
What do you do when you come across a canyon you can't cross? The clever folk of Rim Billiton will find a way: ride the jets of an erupting geyser and fly across the sky!
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: Traffic Warden
stages.desc:
Apart from the clerks making ice cream, the most exhausted person today is the traffic warden directing the crowds. Give him a hand—he's willing to offer a year's supply of carrot cake as thanks.
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: 'Family Reunion'
stages.desc:
Squeak squeak squeak squeak, skritch skritch skritch, quack quack! (Kids, follow me, quick! I found a spot that's tasty and fun!)
<Messenger Angelina> Assists your side in battle. When there are <Floating Letter> on the field, collects them and delivers them into the <Mailbox>

stages.name: A Bold Request
stages.desc: Words are too poor to recreate the feeling of those fluffy little pouches, those tiny claws flailing everywhere, and those springy little tails. So... could I... just once...!

stages.name: A Messenger's Qualities
stages.desc: The livelier and busier the place, the more a messenger needs patience and care. Neglecting one's duties is out of the question—behind every letter are people's feelings and longing.

stages.name: A Letter I Want to Write
stages.desc: Rim Billiton is vast and even more crowded. No matter how well you prepare, you'll always run into unexpected people and things.

stages.name: Candy-Wrapper Stars
stages.desc: The heavy earth lies below; what floats lightly upward is a girl's complicated feelings.

stages.name: Best Wishes, Me at Journey's End
stages.desc: If we meet again, what will we say?

stages.name: Writing Down My Doubts Before Leaving
stages.desc: Whatever the working conditions, Angelina always completes her delivery duties—even in the middle of a festival.

stages.name: Consumables
stages.desc:
The modified hounds have long forgotten the purpose they were born for. They simply run on and on, tireless, ever farther from the body that created them.
<Operation-Only Cover> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.

stages.name: The World Behind the Door
stages.desc:
The woman who has forgotten everything steps through that door. In the cold, dark space there are no screams, only the hollow echo of missing memories.
Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

stages.name: 'Tick-Tock'
stages.desc:
Weak creatures use traps to escape their natural predators. That was the first lesson Lorentz's father taught her.
<Operation-Only Cover> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.
<Originium Explosive> Explodes when destroyed, stunning all nearby units and dealing damage.

stages.name: Runaway Sandbox
stages.desc:
The people watching from behind the bulletproof glass stare in confusion at what is unfolding before them: every computation is running normally, yet the results have spiraled completely out of control, and the lever meant to shut it all down has long since been locked tight.
<Gravity Switches> 'Rocks' and Gravity Switches: Can be activated by heavy enemies and Operators with Block 1 or higher to change the direction of gravity; Operator ASPD and enemy Movement Speed are increased when in the direction of gravity, and reduced when opposed to it.

stages.name: Job Offer
stages.desc:
Ordinarily, extending a job offer to a single learned researcher would not call for such an elaborate operation.
<Operation-Only Cover> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.
<Originium Explosive> Explodes when destroyed, stunning all nearby units and dealing damage.

stages.name: Lab Rules
stages.desc:
Please carry out all operations safely and in an orderly manner, following experimental procedure under the supervision of the relevant project lead, especially when data from preceding experiments is lacking.
<Gravity Switches> 'Rocks' and Gravity Switches: Can be activated by heavy enemies and Operators with Block 1 or higher to change the direction of gravity; Operator ASPD and enemy Movement Speed are increased when in the direction of gravity, and reduced when opposed to it.

stages.name: Uninterrupted Power
stages.desc:
Lorentz's laboratory may not be required to cut its main power, but there is no escaping the twice-daily security inspections.
<Operation-Only Cover> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.

stages.name: The End of Computation
stages.desc:
No one knows how it will all end, yet everyone is hoping. As for the price of that hope, no one is bothering to count it.
Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

stages.name: 'Never Retreat'
stages.desc:
Before this former squad member surges a tide of hounds; behind her are crowds of fleeing citizens and fighters of the True Bolívarians. She raises her shield and vows never to retreat a single step.
<Operation-Only Cover> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.

stages.name: 'Trial Run'
stages.desc:
The blonde Feline presses the button, and the crowded test site instantly falls into a terrible silence. When people enter again, all they find is an empty field. There had never been anything here at all.
<Operation-Only Cover> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.

stages.name: Opening Match
stages.desc:
The first win of the tournament means a great deal to the whole team. Pull together and get off to a winning start!
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Seize the Moment
stages.desc:
The ability to seize opportunities often decides the outcome of an entire match, and this game is the perfect chance for the players to prove what they are truly made of.
<Whirlwind Storm Pitch> Moving tornadoes appear on the pitch, Levitating nearby enemies.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Getting Better
stages.desc:
Beyond tactical planning, good momentum is essential for any team contending for the title. Keep winning and keep morale high!
<Severe Convection Pitch> Lightning strikes the ball on the pitch, dealing damage to and stunning nearby units.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Away Game Streak
stages.desc:
Playing away from home is a rite of passage for every team. Only those who can give their all on unfamiliar ground can become winners worthy of the name.
<Freezing Winter Pitch> Friction is reduced across the whole pitch, and enemy Movement Speed is increased.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Fight for Every Ball
stages.desc:
Before the league matches began, the coaching staff had thoroughly analyzed and studied their opponents. Once the whistle blows, it is up to the players to give it their all on the pitch.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Neck and Neck
stages.desc:
When two evenly matched teams both fail to break through each other's defense, the match must go to a penalty shootout, a test of both skill and willpower.
<Freezing Winter Pitch> Friction is reduced across the whole pitch, and enemy Movement Speed is increased.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Battle for Qualification
stages.desc:
This match decides the one and only qualification spot. Even before kickoff, the atmosphere on and off the pitch is reaching a boiling point.
<Smart Era Pitch> Smart Referees appear on the pitch; a ball that comes near one is picked up and then launched again toward the enemy's half.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Clash of Styles
stages.desc:
A clash of tactical philosophies is always a crowd favorite. Set today's war of words aside for now; the final score will prove everything.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Strike First
stages.desc:
The cheer squad braved the downpour to get here, all to witness their team claim a resounding victory. Don't let them down!
<Severe Convection Pitch> Lightning strikes the ball on the pitch, dealing damage to and stunning nearby units.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Watch Your Step
stages.desc:
The knockout rounds have reached their most intense stage. Teams willing to win by any means necessary are hardly rare, so do not let your guard down for a moment.
<Whirlwind Storm Pitch> Moving tornadoes appear on the pitch, Levitating nearby enemies.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Road to the Title
stages.desc:
Everyone can see the championship trophy already waiting at the side of the pitch. After this final showdown, the champions will be crowned before the eyes of the crowd.
<Penalty Shootout> If the score is tied when the countdown ends, the match goes to a penalty shootout.
<Quick-Finish Rule> In this match, a team that reaches a 5-goal lead wins immediately.

stages.name: Endurance Drill
stages.desc:
Positional Football tests the stamina of every player on the field, and abundant stamina often translates into a tactical advantage. That is why endurance training is indispensable.
<Random Team> Each match pits you against a random opponent: the Field Team, Tactical Team, or Straightball Team.
<Random Pitch> Each match is played on a random pitch: Freezing Winter Pitch, Smart Era Pitch, Severe Convection Pitch, Whirlwind Storm Pitch, or Regular Pitch.

stages.name: Dribbling Practice
stages.desc:
Over the years, all kinds of tactics have emerged on the pitch, but whatever the tactic, ball control has always been its unshakable core. This training session is designed precisely to sharpen your dribbling.
<Random Team> Each match pits you against a random opponent: the Door Gods, Ball Mania Club, Sportsmen United, or Magic Ball Gang.
<Random Pitch> Each match is played on a random pitch: Freezing Winter Pitch, Smart Era Pitch, Severe Convection Pitch, Whirlwind Storm Pitch, or Regular Pitch.

stages.name: First Training
stages.desc: Every team starts out on the training ground. Step onto the field and begin with the most basic training drills!

stages.name: Coward Under the Shell
stages.desc:
Village Apothecary: Oh dear, the herb garden's been ravaged again! This time it's not bugs, but a bunch of slippery critters carrying eggshells on their backs—Shellcrusher Newts! Honored hunter, please toss these 'rocks with legs' out for me. My back's about to give out!
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Give Me Back My Pot!
stages.desc:
Hot-Tempered Head Chef: This drives me up the wall! It's those Shellthief Bugs again! Nothing they love more than crawling into pots and pans in the middle of the night and running off wearing them. Honored hunter, please give them a good thrashing and get our stolen cookware back!
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Never Let Your Guard Down
stages.desc:
'Aberrant Hunter' Orchid: Before challenging an 'Aberrant', you must first learn to protect yourself, then hone your combat skills by hunting beasts. Catapult, I know you'll see this mission. If you don't finish it, there's no dinner for you tonight.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Omen of Red Snow
stages.desc:
General Midnight of the Bubbly Realm: Our scouts have sent an urgent report—lava is flowing from the snowy mountains in the direction of the 'Royal Wheel'. For the safety of the Bubbly Realm, and so that you may all return home, I ask that you go and investigate. Be sure to beware of that ominous heat.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Failure Is Not an Option
stages.desc:
General Midnight of the Bubbly Realm: This will be a big gamble. If I... if the trap fails, I leave Her Majesty in your hands. No matter what, you must hold this place. That is my only request.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Ghosts from the Past
stages.desc:
Samurai Captain of the Bubbly Realm: Unbelievable... the Cursed Oni, long since extinct, have come back to life! Honored hunter, please hold them back! If the pack breaks through here, the capital will be in danger!
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Why Is Everyone So Stubborn?
stages.desc:
Banmiluo, Blacksmith of the Bubbly Realm: That Midnight sure knows how to put people to work. Oh well, let's go. Hunting party, you all follow along too. I'm actually pretty curious what it looks like under the 'Royal Wheel'.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Fate Turns, Azure Thunder Surges
stages.desc:
Baowujia, Sovereign of the Bubbly Realm: To suppress the rampage of the 'Royal Wheel', we must harness the power of the 'Lord of Thunder'. Miss Orchid, Miss Catapult, Banmiluo, and... Midnight, please lend me your strength!
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: For the Future of the Mirage Nation?
stages.desc:
Banmiluo, Blacksmith of the Bubbly Realm: This whole 'mobile city' idea is way too interesting. If it could actually be done... Anyway, I need someone to catch a whole bunch of Shellthief Bugs for me. Go ask Midnight for your pay—just tell him it's research for the nation's future.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Migration Season
stages.desc:
Earnest Ecologist: A colony of Crowncall Wyverns is migrating, and a group of Great Gluttons lives along their migration route. If the wyverns whet the Great Gluttons' appetites, it could deal a major blow to the surrounding ecosystem. Would anyone willing please come up with a solution?
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: The Perfect Training Ground
stages.desc:
Baowujia, Sovereign of the Bubbly Realm: Besides head-on combat, I must also become familiar with other hunting techniques, lest Midnight worry again. To that end, I have found a superb training ground. Those who wish to hone their skills, come with me.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Protect the 'Royal Wheel'
stages.desc:
General Midnight of the Bubbly Realm: A pack of beasts is approaching the 'Royal Wheel', seemingly intent on destroying it. Even though we now know part of its truth, the 'Royal Wheel' remains an important symbol of our nation, so they must be stopped.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: A New Outpost
stages.desc:
Optimistic Soldier: We found a great spot for a new outpost. The only problem is there's no high ground around to build a watchtower on. Now we need someone to lure some Rockshell Beasts over here—they seem really good at making high ground. As for what happens once they arrive—we'll figure something out!
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: A New Beast Tide?
stages.desc:
General Midnight of the Bubbly Realm: A new beast tide is forming. But we've already learned the habits of the Shadowsilk Spiders—if we can guide their movements, we can nip this tide in the bud. Let's go, hunters. It's time for the hunt.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: The Final 'Curse'
stages.desc:
Baowujia, Sovereign of the Bubbly Realm: This should be the last pack of beasts affected by the 'curse' leaking from the 'Royal Wheel'. Once they're eliminated, the Bubbly Realm will know true peace. Midnight, Banmiluo, hunters—thank you all for your hard work.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: A Flash Across the Land, Thunder Resounds
stages.desc:
I was taking a walk in the quiet forest when thunder suddenly came crashing down, meow! It was a Zinogre that called down the lightning, meow...! I was scared half to death, my whiskers won't stop trembling, meow—! We can't just leave that thing be, meow. Please find a way to take it down, meow.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: 'Stampede of a Hundred Beasts'
stages.desc:
Banmiluo, Blacksmith of the Bubbly Realm: I've reinforced the defenses against the beast tide—no ordinary beast will ever get near our city again. Now I need someone to test them out. Anyone not afraid of dying—I mean, anyone brave?
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: Mountains Tremble, a Hundred Dragons Roam the Night
stages.desc:
You don't know why you're here, nor where exactly here is, but you know what you have to do—defeat them and survive. Simple as that.
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

stages.name: The Sandstorm Rises
stages.desc: Laid-back Personnel Operator: This field mission is about dealing with a band of sand bandits holed up in the desert. They're crafty, but with A6's current skills, you'll be fine. Good luck—I'll have snacks ready when you get back!

stages.name: The Dream Ends, the Hunter's Soul Endures
stages.desc:
Reserve Op Team A6 Captain Orchid: Even if this is only a dream, I will remember everything that happened here. Until we meet again.
Reserve Op Team A6 Member Catapult: As long as I keep hunting, maybe we'll meet again someday. Bye!

stages.name: Hunting Is the Best!
stages.desc:
'Aberrant Hunter' Catapult: Oh my gosh, flying around in the sky is way too much fun! I don't care anymore, I'm taking the Wirebug out to play! Orchid, I know you'll see this mission. Don't worry, I'll be back for dinner!
<Wirebug> Used by Operators; hitting an enemy that can be Wyvern Ridden increases Wyvern Riding progress

items.d: Decades later, the salvage workers who picked these periscopes up from the ruins were more familiar with another use for them: taking them to the ration office to exchange for an extra portion of food.
items.u: A handheld periscope. Whenever an expedition fleet returned to port, the crowds of onlookers were always so vast that those in the back rows had to rely on periscopes to catch a glimpse of the treasures from the sea.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: An ordinary floor sign. After being used to denote acceleration points in stool racing competitions, operators interested in these competitions have become rather fond of it, eventually turning it into a collectible.
items.u: Can be exchanged at Breakthrough Milestones for rewards.

items.d: "O clear morning light, sweet as your voice. I lose myself in dreams and reappear within your eyes. For you I offer up my own eyes, forgetting all that I have seen, all that was once seen by me."
items.u: It holds music that was once all the rage in Laterano. Laterans today are more used to streaming services for new songs, but some still cherish these old things and will gladly trade what you need for them.

items.d: A commemorative badge made by the exhibition organizers, stamped with the Wondrous Exhibition logo.
items.u: A commemorative badge obtained during the Wondrous Exhibition. Can be exchanged for various rewards.

items.evName: Until the Land Becomes a Lime
items.d: Perhaps they met someone interesting, perhaps they came away with a profound realization, or perhaps something simply happened that makes them laugh whenever they recall it. One journey has ended, and they have far too many memories they want to share.
items.u: Curious what sort of journey the girls had on their long trip? Find a comfortable corner, sit down, and have a glass of carrot juice. They're not only happy to tell you the story—they'll share the gifts they brought back from afar.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: A dim light pierced a vast hole through Their body, and a black sun rose from the rainforests of Bolivar; the dripping Dark Current festered the golden streams. The hunters were born out of that agony, and from then on had to devour all things to fill a wound that would never close.
items.u: After dissecting a hound that had attacked and devoured a human body, we were astonished to find not a single trace of food in its digestive organs—and moreover, its entire set of internal organs seemed no more than an empty shell. Then where does the energy for its movement come from, and where has the consumed mass gone?

items.d: A digital point voucher prepared by the tournament organizers for participants. It records each player's on-field performance, and the champion's voucher is said to carry a special visual effect.
items.u: Used to exchange for various supplies in the Positional Football Championship.

items.d: Shattered bone fragments found in the barrens, weathered by wind for years. Their original, complete form can no longer be identified. Perhaps they once belonged to some great beast, but now they are nothing but low-grade materials that can be found anywhere.
items.u: A common low-grade material usable in Alchemy.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: Bamboo from the grove transformed by the intense heat of the Molten Snail. Usable across many production fields, it fetches a good price in the markets of the Bubble Kingdom.
items.u: A regular material usable in Alchemy, obtainable by putting in just a little bit of work.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: An insect that glows when stimulated, appearing in the bamboo grove only at night. Usable as weapon material or as a light source, it is highly popular in the Bubble Kingdom—though the grove at night is dangerous enough to make gathering difficult.
items.u: A fine material usable in Alchemy, obtainable by putting in a fair amount of work.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: A material made from the Molten Snail's shell. As the snail crawls, ores accumulate on its shell; scorched over long years, it becomes beautiful and hard, making a highly durable material.
items.u: A rare, high-grade material usable in Alchemy.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: A peculiar crystal found around the Molten Snail after the hunt of that "Beast" is complete. Its surface is ice, yet flame seems wrapped within. Extremely rare, and said to draw out equipment's potential when used in crafting.
items.u: An extremely rare, top-of-the-line material usable in Alchemy.
items.o: Event Stage drop, Event mission reward

items.d: A rare gemstone Zinogre occasionally forms within its body. The concentrated image of a king's power.
items.u: A material obtained in battle with Zinogre—ideal as an alchemy reagent.

enemies.desc: The most common beast around the Mirage Nation. A herd animal that feeds on bamboo. Though very weak, it breeds prolifically, and its image can be found even in the Mirage Nation's oldest texts.

Is Frightened for a long time while <'Lord of Thunder'> is on the field

enemies.name: Crowncall Wyvern King
enemies.desc: The leader of a Crowncall Wyvern herd. It makes loud noises through its nose to warn its herd to flee—though it's usually also the fastest runner in the herd.
abil: Becomes Frightened for a while when other nearby enemy units die
Is Frightened for a long time while <'Lord of Thunder'> is on the field

enemies.name: Shellcrusher Newt
enemies.desc: A newt that lives deep in the bamboo forests. Timid by nature, it carries around the eggshell it hatched from so it can hide inside at any moment.
abil: Stops attacking and curls up when allied units are nearby or <'Lord of Thunder'> is on the field

enemies.name: Daimyo Shellcrusher Newt
enemies.desc: An elder among Shellcrusher Newts. Over long years it has hardened its shell in every way possible, so that now even a Great Glutton can't easily crack it—at the cost of never being able to take it off again.
abil: Stops attacking and curls up when allied units are nearby or <'Lord of Thunder'> is on the field

enemies.name: Shellthief Bug
enemies.desc: A mollusk that lives in bamboo forests. Its body is tiny and frail, so it likes to find large containers to use as a shelter, retreating into them at the first sign of danger.
abil: Has a Barrier with a certain amount of HP

enemies.name: Yokozuna Shellthief Bug
enemies.desc: A strongman among Shellthief Bugs. Not content with finding containers to protect itself, it's eager for containers that let it prove itself. After hearing about the customs of Terra from Orchid and Catapult, Banmira began hoping that one day they could carry an entire house.
abil: Has a Barrier with a certain amount of HP

enemies.name: Great Glutton
enemies.desc: A large beast that lives in the snowy mountains. It is massive with powerful forelimbs, easily grabbing small beasts and even grown adults to swallow them whole. The Mirage Nation has many legends about it used to scare children.
abil: Can devour other nearby enemies with a weight of 2 or less; afterwards, its next attack has increased range and deals AoE damage

enemies.name: Wrathful Great Glutton
enemies.desc: A gourmet among Great Gluttons. Far more docile than an ordinary Great Glutton, so the legends about it have turned from scary tales into warm stories of protection. In truth, it has simply eaten so many things that its palate has grown picky.
abil: Can devour other nearby enemies with a weight of 2 or less; afterwards, its next attack has increased range and deals AoE damage

enemies.name: Flipshell Turtle
enemies.desc: An ordinary tortoise, found near underground waterways. Extremely aggressive—the moment it sees a living thing, it withdraws into its shell and rams it at great speed. Those who see it for the first time often can't react in time.
abil: Deals crushing damage when passing through allied units without being blocked
Wyvern Riding: Flipshell Turtle rolls to the designated position and then disappears, dealing True damage and Slow to all ground enemies along the way

enemies.name: Flipshell Turtle - Bound
enemies.desc: A Flipshell Turtle eroded by the 'Curse'. Under its effect, its shell has become immensely heavy, and its movement speed has changed eerily—sometimes it seems slow, but in the blink of an eye it's right in front of you, catching you off guard.
abil: Deals crushing damage when passing through allied units without being blocked
Wyvern Riding: Flipshell Turtle - Bound rolls to the designated position and then disappears, dealing True damage and Slow to all ground enemies along the way

enemies.name: Shadowsilk Spider
enemies.desc: A spider widespread in the underground bamboo forests. It weaves extremely sticky webs between the bamboo; one careless step and you'll be caught and become its meal.

enemies.name: Shadowsilk Spider - Grudge
enemies.desc: A Shadowsilk Spider eroded by the 'Curse'—a very troublesome foe. The threads it spits carry some of the 'Curse's' power; once entangled, you either become its meal or a prisoner of the 'Curse'.
abil: Shoots spider silk at the allied unit with the highest current HP within attack range, continuously inflicting Stun and Arts damage

enemies.name: Cursed Oni
enemies.desc: Wolves long extinct in the Mirage Nation have reappeared alongside the calamity. They possess every trait a wolf should—pack tactics, ferocity, cunning—and each has become all the more troublesome because of the 'Curse'.

ATK decreases each time it takes damage, up to 10 times

enemies.name: Cursed Oni - True
enemies.desc: The true 'Cursed Oni'. It appears in all manner of ancient texts of the Mirage Nation, regarded as the harbinger of ruin. It retains a wolf's habits, but both its running and biting carry the property of the 'Curse', bringing great calamity upon the Mirage Nation.
abil: Attacks deal Arts damage in a triple strike
ATK decreases each time it takes damage, up to 12 times

enemies.name: Rockshell Beast
enemies.desc: A beast never before seen in the Mirage Nation. Any foe who comes near is torn apart by its immensely powerful forelimbs, while prey that tries to flee finds its escape sealed off by the rock walls it raises.
abil: Flings 'Weathered Debris' onto the 4 surrounding ground tiles, making them undeployable
Wyvern Riding: Rockshell Beast bursts out at the designated position, flinging 'Entrenched Rock Peaks' that Operators can be deployed on onto the 4 surrounding tiles, then leaves

enemies.name: Rockshell Beast - Curse
enemies.desc: A Rockshell Beast eroded by the 'Curse'. The 'Curse' has strengthened its forelimbs, granting it the power to reshape terrain with ease. It is the only creature that could threaten the 'Lord of Thunder', and so it became the 'Lord of Thunder's' main quarry.
abil: Flings 'Weathered Debris' onto the 4 surrounding ground tiles, making them undeployable

enemies.name: 'Aberrant' Magma Snail
enemies.desc: The current 'Aberrant', ruler of the lava lands. It wields the power of the 'Curse' and seeks to turn the snowy mountains into its nest.

enemies.name: Dripping Ice Cream
enemies.desc:
A melting ice cream. No matter how hard you try, you can't stop it dripping onto your hand.
It can appear anywhere on the streets—perhaps as often as real ice cream in Laterano. After all, ice cream always melts.
It's very fragile; anything can hurt it. Whether the dripping cream is tears, no one knows. You've surely never tasted tears this sweet.
abil: Weakness: Physical, Arts, Elemental. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage

enemies.name: Slurping Ice Cream
enemies.desc:
Ice cream spilled all over the ground. You tried, but it fell anyway.
It can appear anywhere on the streets—perhaps as often as real ice cream in Laterano. After all, ice cream always melts.
It's very fragile; anything can hurt it. Whether the flowing cream is tears, no one knows. You would never taste cream off the ground.
abil: Weakness: Physical, Arts, Elemental. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage

enemies.name: Noisy Radio
enemies.desc:
A broken radio. It desperately wants someone to hear it.
Its voice coil still vibrates, but the sounds it makes mean nothing. Very noisy—luckily, Lateranos can't hear it.
Its internals are easily disrupted by Originium Arts, so it learned to hit people with its turntable instead. That works.
abil: Weakness: Arts, Elemental. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage

enemies.name: Silent Radio
enemies.desc:
A scrapped radio. It has given up on using sound to get attention.
Its voice coil still vibrates, but no sound comes out at all. It's so quiet that sometimes it doesn't even notice itself.
Its internals are easily disrupted by Originium Arts, so it learned to hit people with its turntable instead. That works.
abil: Weakness: Arts, Elemental. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage

enemies.name: Hopping Fowlbeast
enemies.desc:
A Fowlbeast tangled in a net. With the net draped over its head, it can't escape no matter which way it flies.
The good news: it can still fly. The bad news: it can't fly very high, so it easily bumps into streetlamps, confessional cars, flowerbeds, or anything else.
Hitting Fowlbeasts is not recommended. They're very sensitive to pain.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Weakness: Physical. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage

enemies.name: Tottering Fowlbeast
enemies.desc:
A Fowlbeast deeply tangled in a net. The net has wrapped around its wings, and it doesn't understand why its body feels so heavy.
The good news: it can still fly. The bad news: it can't fly very high, so it easily bumps into saint statues' knees, confessional car wheels, roadside steps, or anything else.
Hitting Fowlbeasts is not recommended. They're very sensitive to pain.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Weakness: Physical. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage

enemies.name: Heartbreak Bouquet
enemies.desc:
A rose wilted from lack of water. It is beginning to understand that it cannot convey its feelings.
Actually, it can. When a bouquet of roses shows up in a trash can, most people know what happened.
Dried petals are very soft, but pulling them off for a love fortune is not recommended. Far too unlucky.
abil: Weakness: Physical. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage
Immune to Elemental damage

enemies.name: Divorce Bouquet
enemies.desc:
A scorched, withered rose. It has already understood that 'conveying one's feelings' was never possible.
Actually, it can. When a bouquet of roses shows up in a courthouse trash can, even if you don't know the details, you know it's not good news.
Withered petals are light and soft, but pulling them off for a love fortune is not recommended. Far too unlucky.
abil: Weakness: Physical. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage
Immune to Elemental damage

enemies.name: Stuttering Gun
enemies.desc:
A knotted gun. It finally decided to fire, only to find the bullet coming back at it.
Will, wisdom, and a clear barrel are all indispensable to a clean shot. It realized it has none of them.
Try disrupting its circuits with specialized Originium Arts. It can't get any worse anyway.

enemies.name: Roaring Gun
enemies.desc:
A gun with a burst barrel. It finally decided to fire—doesn't a burst barrel count as a hit? Just because the target was itself?
Will, wisdom, and a clear barrel are all indispensable to a clean shot. It realized it has none of them, but whatever.

enemies.name: Blinding Streetlamp
enemies.desc:
A flickering streetlamp. The light of life that illuminates Laterano's nights—with a bit of a loose connection.
A beautiful, holy light protects us and drives back the night. But only for five seconds, three seconds, or one. Hard to say.
It's made of good materials and is very sturdy. To break it, either study specialized Originium Arts or put in more muscle.

When you tell it it's only eight, it cries out in shock: Wasn't it already eight twelve hours ago?!
Without knowledge of Originium Arts, it's hard to set a clock right.

enemies.name: Don't-Know Clock
enemies.desc:
A completely muddled clock. It has no idea what time it is, and it's in no hurry at all.
When you tell it it's eight o'clock, it mutters indifferently: What's the difference? What's it to me?

"An ice cream scramble? Back in the day, me and my cart took first place in the mining district's ore-hauling race. Carrot ice cream? Watch and learn!"
abil: When not driving, drives a nearby <Hand-Pushed Mine Cart>
ATK and DEF greatly increased while driving a <Hand-Pushed Mine Cart>

enemies.name: First-Place Miner
enemies.desc:
A miner who has figured out what's going on and is pushing his cart, ready to haul off a whole load of carrot ice cream.
Staking his pride as a miner of ten years, he is determined to take first place in this contest.
abil: When not driving, drives a nearby <Legendary Mine Cart>
ATK and DEF greatly increased while driving a <Legendary Mine Cart>

enemies.name: Hand-Pushed Mine Cart
enemies.desc: A battle-hardened mine cart, waiting for a pusher who understands it.
abil: Invulnerable

enemies.name: Legendary Mine Cart
enemies.desc: A legendary mine cart as old as Great Springs Town itself, waiting for someone worthy of it.
abil: Invulnerable

enemies.name: 'Little Hat'
enemies.desc:
A baby Marsupial Musbeast drawn by the smell of ice cream. It's left its southern home for the first time and come to Great Springs Town—and it wants everything!
"Squeak squeak squeak squeak, quack quack!" Someone guessed at a translation: "All these good things are mine!"
abil: Flying unit.
Does not reduce Life Points upon entering the Objective Point
When not carrying a <Floating Letter>, snatches a <Floating Letter> within its attack range

enemies.name: 'Big Cape'
enemies.desc:
A Marsupial Musbeast drawn by the smell of ice cream. Its eyes are closed, but those around it can still feel its longing gaze toward the ice cream.
"Squeak squeak squeak—swish swish!" This time the guessed translation is: "I can steal all your stuff with my eyes closed!"
abil: Flying unit.
Does not reduce Life Points upon entering the Objective Point
When not carrying a <Floating Letter>, snatches a <Floating Letter> within its attack range

enemies.name: Joyful School Bus
enemies.desc:
A school bus that heard an event was being held here and brought over all the students let out early.
But it seems it's not just students—others squeezed aboard in the confusion too!
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Loads nearby non-Leader, non-Mechanical enemies as passengers (up to 2); releases them when defeated

enemies.name: Festival School Bus
enemies.desc:
A school bus that heard an event was being held here and brought over all the students let out early. It even hung up a few strings of little flags to match the mood.
The driver no longer seems to care who the passengers are—anyone who can liven things up is welcome aboard.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Loads nearby non-Leader, non-Mechanical enemies as passengers (up to 2); releases them when defeated

enemies.name: Nickname Enthusiast
enemies.desc:
A young person at the peak of their energy who wants to do something here to earn a cooler-sounding nickname.
"Mischief Mailman" sounds pretty good—way better than their current "Speedy Legs"!
abil: On its first attack, drops a <'Surprise Letter'> at the target's position

enemies.name: Big-Score Chaser
enemies.desc:
A young person at the peak of their energy who has given up on getting a new nickname and only thinks about pulling off something big to wow everyone.
Let's take the excitement up a notch—hehe, 'Surprise Letter' delivery in progress!
abil: On its first attack, drops a <'Surprise Letter'> at the target's position

enemies.name: 'Surprise Letter'
enemies.desc:
A little envelope holding a 'surprise'. Best be careful when opening it.
What flew out? Whoosh—pop!
abil: Flying unit.
Starts a 5-second countdown upon spawning; when the countdown ends, dies and deals Physical damage and Stun to nearby allied units
When taking damage, moves to the position of the damage source and resets its countdown

enemies.name: 'Temptation of Gourmet'
enemies.desc:
A unicycle powered by a small beast on top that runs after a carrot. The driver usually just needs to pretend to pedal underneath.
Just a little more, just a little more—the fragrant, sweet carrot is almost mine, almost mine!
abil: When affected by Levitate or Shift, takes a big tumble and becomes incapacitated, dealing True damage to other nearby enemy units at the same time
After being incapacitated, its DEF, RES, and Movement Speed are permanently reduced

enemies.name: 'Slave to Gourmet'
enemies.desc:
A unicycle powered by a small beast on top that runs after a carrot. The goggles the driver wears are just for show.
A driver who can't pedal after the beast finally eats the carrot and runs off without a trace earns the nickname 'Beansprout'.
abil: When affected by Levitate or Shift, takes a big tumble and becomes incapacitated, dealing True damage to other nearby enemy units at the same time
After being incapacitated, its DEF, RES, and Movement Speed are permanently reduced

enemies.name: Graceful Knife Chef
enemies.desc:
An elegant and beautiful lady who brought fresh ingredients from home to add a little more flavor to the festival.
The way she slices carrots is a treat to watch—so pleasant that you can't help but give her an extra ice cream.
abil: Increases the ASPD and RES of ground enemies within a certain range around itself

enemies.name: Dazzling Knife Chef
enemies.desc:
A kind and gentle lady who brought the equipment passed down from her mother's mother to add a little warmth to the festival.
Once the national carrot-slicing champion. Watching her dazzling knifework, no one dares not give her an extra ice cream.
abil: Increases the ASPD and RES of ground enemies within a certain range around itself

enemies.name: Kindhearted Boss
enemies.desc:
The owner of a pizzeria in the next town. Rumor has it he trained in Siracusa, and he wants to offer free pizza at this event to build his name.
The old man's smile is warm, but the pizza he makes tastes...
abil: Flying unit.
Continuously bombs the ground and high ground at its position, dealing AoE Physical damage

enemies.name: Passionate Boss
enemies.desc:
The owner of a pizzeria in the next town. Rumor has it he added his own twist to Siracusan pizza-making, and he plans to show off his skills at this event.
"Get that old man down from there! A real Siracusan actually came today!!!"
abil: Flying unit.
Continuously bombs the ground and high ground at its position, dealing AoE Physical damage

enemies.name: Floating Letter
enemies.desc:
A letter not yet dropped into the mailbox.
Careful—don't let the Marsupial Musbeasts steal it.
abil: Flying unit.
After taking a certain number of hits, moves to the position of the damage source

enemies.name: Messenger Angelina
enemies.desc:
Rhodes Island's messenger, Angelina.
The excitement of this contest is beyond imagination, but she believes she can handle it all—after all, she's a seasoned messenger now!
abil: Flying friendly unit
Prioritizes picking up <Floating Letter> on the field and posting them into the <Mailbox>
Periodically, and after posting a <Floating Letter>, selects multiple allied Operators on the field, restoring some SP to them and increasing their ASPD for a while
Attacks several enemies around herself, inflicting Levitate and Slow for a while

When the <Mailbox> is filled, immediately attacks all enemies around herself, inflicting Levitate and Slow for a long time. Each time the <Mailbox> is filled, the number of allied Operators she selects, the SP she restores to them, and the ASPD she grants them permanently increase. Also permanently increases the number of enemies she attacks and the duration of the Levitate and Slow she inflicts

enemies.name: 'Lord of Thunder'
enemies.desc: The previous 'Aberrant', named 'Lord of Thunder' for the lightning coiling around its body. It is said that when hunting, it gathers countless thunderbugs to dramatically amplify the electricity around it, entering a 'supercharged state'.
abil: Charging State
[Charge Up] Charges up in place; each successful charge adds 1 Charge stack. Upon reaching a certain number of stacks, enters the Supercharged State
[Thunderous Roar] Stuns all units within a certain radius centered on itself for a while

[Thunder Pounce] After charging, leaps to an area within a certain range with many allied units, dealing damage to allied units within a certain range. Then charges again and leaps to an area within a certain range that allied units' attack ranges barely cover, performing [Charge Up] 2 times

[Azure Thunder Charge] Charges up and locks onto 1 allied unit within a certain range, then charges at it; the charge stops upon hitting high ground. Deals damage to allied units it passes through. Then performs [Charge Up] 2 times

[Homing Lightning Orbs] After charging, leaps to an area within a certain range that allied units' attack ranges barely cover, and fires 3 lightning orbs that deal Arts damage. Then performs [Charge Up] 2 times
Supercharged State
[Azure Thunder Armor] Immune to Paralysis; gains Status Resistance
[Thunder Dispersal] After taking a certain amount of damage or being Wyvern Ridden, returns to the Charging State
[True Thunderous Roar] Stuns all units within a certain radius centered on itself for a while and gains increased ATK for a duration
[Chain Heavy Thunder Slam] After charging, leaps to an area within a certain range with many allied units, dealing damage 3 times to allied units within a certain range
[Thunder-Wreathed Charge] Charges up and locks onto 1 allied unit within a certain range, then charges at it; the charge stops upon hitting high ground. Deals damage to allied units it passes through
[Scattering Lightning Orbs] After charging, leaps to an area within a certain range that allied units' attack ranges barely cover, and fires 6 lightning orbs that deal Arts damage
Wyvern Riding State

[Wyvern Riding - Azure Thunder Charge] After 'Wyvern Riding: Zinogre' is placed, the 'Lord of Thunder' charges in the target direction. Colliding with high ground while charging deals heavy damage to itself. If it collides with high ground twice while ridden, the 'Lord of Thunder' is knocked down for a while, during which its DEF and RES are reduced, and its tail is severed after it takes a certain amount of damage

enemies.name: 'Congealed Will to Die'
enemies.desc: It's a very simple wish. As simple as wanting to live, and just as hard to shake off.
abil: Immune to Stun, but can be knocked down by attacks on its weakness
Starts in its First Form; each time it recovers from being knocked down, switches between its First and Second Form. Its weakness differs by form

The first time its HP reaches 0, enters a revival phase, during which it attacks 6 times, dealing Arts damage to all allied units on the field, then revives after a while. After reviving, can use [Final Reward], and when hit by a damage type it is immune to, reflects part of the damage it would have taken
[Final Reward] After charging for a while, all allied units take heavy True damage; the charge is interrupted if it is knocked down
First Form
Increased ASPD
Weakness: Physical. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage
Immune to Arts damage
[Hope for the Future] After attacking 2 times, the next attack deals heavy Physical damage
Second Form
Increased Movement Speed; Unblockable
Weakness: Arts. Is knocked down for a while after taking a certain amount of the corresponding damage
Immune to Physical damage
[Regrets of the Past] After attacking 2 times, the next attack deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK 6 times to all allied units within range

enemies.name: Saint Valerio
enemies.desc: If the Inquisition cannot, he will create meaning for his sacrifice with his own hands.
abil: Gains a certain percentage of damage reduction and ATK bonus for each <Plastic Matrix> held
Gradually loses <Plastic Matrix> inside a [Plastic Field]
[Recompense] Locks onto several tiles, then after charging fires a hand cannon at them, dealing splash Physical damage and Stun; if it defeats an allied unit, leaves behind an <Unyielding Flame>
[Judgment] After attacking several times, unleashes a multi-hit attack on all allied units within a certain range ahead; the number of hits increases with the <Plastic Matrix> held

[Excommunication] When an allied Operator within a certain range is defeated or retreats, deals Arts damage once and leaves a fire that continuously deals Arts damage and Burn, and all nearby enemies below the cap gain 1 <Plastic Matrix>. Ineffective inside a [Plastic Field]
Immune to Stun, but enters [Paralysis] when <Plastic Matrix> exceeds the cap
[Paralysis] Stunned continuously for a period of time, loses all <Plastic Matrix>, and cannot absorb <Plastic Matrix>
First Form
<Saint Valerio> attacks deal Physical damage; <Plastic Matrix> cap: 6
Second Form
<Saint Valerio> attacks deal Arts damage; <Plastic Matrix> cap: 7
Allied units around <Saint Valerio> continuously take Arts damage and Burn

enemies.name: 'Sound-Asleep Pilot'
enemies.desc:
The biggest Marsupial Musbeast anyone has ever seen! It's curled up among its hoard of treasures, sleeping remarkably soundly.
What happens if you wake it? Or rather... can it even be woken? How is it flying while asleep?!
abil: [Where'd It Go...] Can carry several copies of <Floating Letter>; each one carried increases DEF and RES
[Treasure Hunt] Casts continuously, absorbing <Floating Letter> and <'Super Surprise Letter'> on the field

[Patrol Raid] Enters a flying state for a while. While flying, continuously bombs the ground and high ground at its position, dealing AoE Physical damage. Lands immediately after being blocked for a few seconds.
[Eek, Got Careless!] Is incapacitated for a while upon landing; while incapacitated, drops 1 <Floating Letter> each time it takes a certain number of hits
[Super Surprise Delivery] Selects multiple allied units and drops a <'Super Surprise Letter'> at their positions
The first time its HP reaches 0, carpet-bombs the rows of 3 allied units that have not taken off. Gains the [Territory Declared!] skill after reviving
[Territory Declared!] Selects several allied units that have not taken off and carpet-bombs the rows they are in

enemies.name: 'Super Surprise Letter'
enemies.desc:
A glittering golden envelope that makes you wonder what on earth is inside.
Let's take a peek... Whoosh—bang!
abil: Flying unit.
Starts a 5-second countdown upon spawning; when the countdown ends, dies and deals Physical damage and Stun to nearby allied units
When taking damage, moves to the position of the damage source and resets its countdown

enemies.name: Fashion Street 'Drifting Tourist'
enemies.desc: A fluffy critter happily wandering all over the amusement park. It's curious about every attraction and will even peek into places marked 'Staff Only'. Don't even think about stamping out its spirit of exploration!
abil: Continuously seeks out the nearest Fun Cloud and tries to break it; stops attacking if an allied unit is inside

enemies.name: Fashion Street 'Eager Guide'
enemies.desc: A fluffy critter that works as a guide in the amusement park. Watch out when you hear the noisy fan on its back, because a huge crowd is about to come flooding in to gather!
abil: Marks the nearest Objective Point, changing the destination of all enemies to that point
Will not mark if a mark from another 'Eager Guide' is already on the field

enemies.name: Cloud Extra
enemies.desc: A fluffy critter holding up a pink cloud sign at the amusement park. Don't underestimate these usually drowsy Fluffies. When the park closes and their shift ends, they have set records for how fast they clear out!
abil: If blown out of a Fun Cloud by a Surprise Storm or a Fashion Street 'Drifting Tourist', its Max HP is greatly increased and it becomes Unblockable

enemies.name: Magic Ball Gang Shooter
enemies.desc: What keeps the Magic Ball Gang standing on the pitch is the team's utterly unpredictable dribbling. The Fair Play Committee has inspected the masks worn by Magic Ball Gang Shooters many times, yet has never figured out how this gear keeps even cameras from capturing their movements.
abil: Periodically teleports a certain distance toward the ball

enemies.name: Magic Ball Gang Sly Shooter
enemies.desc: What keeps the Magic Ball Gang standing on the pitch is the team's utterly unpredictable dribbling. The Magic Ball Gang's home stage isn't just the pitch. When there are no matches, it puts on public magic shows, with the team's shooters as the star performers.
abil: Periodically teleports a certain distance toward the ball

enemies.name: Magic Ball Gang Goalie
enemies.desc: What keeps the Magic Ball Gang standing on the pitch is the team's utterly unpredictable dribbling. Wear that top hat that lets you reposition in an instant, and you too can skip goalkeeping training altogether, just like the Magic Ball Gang Goalies.
abil: Periodically teleports a certain distance toward the ball while it is stationary

enemies.name: Magic Ball Gang Sly Goalie
enemies.desc: What keeps the Magic Ball Gang standing on the pitch is the team's utterly unpredictable dribbling. Some have speculated that their eye masks are actually high-precision positioning devices, but sadly, no one has ever managed to gather enough evidence to prove it.
abil: Periodically teleports a certain distance toward the ball while it is stationary

enemies.name: Magic Ball Gang Hitter
enemies.desc: What keeps the Magic Ball Gang standing on the pitch is the team's utterly unpredictable dribbling. Magic Ball Gang players excel at suddenly slipping behind opponents to attack, and rumor has it that even assassin organizations have come to the team to recruit new talent.
abil: Prioritizes searching for your units near the ball, and periodically teleports a certain distance toward a nearby target

enemies.name: Magic Ball Gang Sly Hitter
enemies.desc: What keeps the Magic Ball Gang standing on the pitch is the team's utterly unpredictable dribbling. For opponents, disrupting the Magic Ball Gang's formation is always extremely difficult, because you simply can't see where these players are.
abil: Prioritizes searching for your units near the ball, and periodically teleports a certain distance toward a nearby target

enemies.name: Door Gods Shooter
enemies.desc: The Door Gods' football philosophy is very simple: if you never concede, you can never lose. The Door Gods have been voted 'Most Rookie-Forward-Friendly Club' three years running, naturally because the bar for selection is extremely low: all you need to do is pass the ball back to the goalie.
abil: Passes the ball back to the goalie after touching it

enemies.name: Door Gods Loyal Shooter
enemies.desc: The Door Gods' football philosophy is very simple: if you never concede, you can never lose. One of the reasons the Door Gods have kept going this long, and with such impressive results, is that their forwards' appearance tends to make opponents drop their guard.
abil: Passes the ball back to the goalie after touching it

enemies.name: Door Gods Goalie
enemies.desc: The Door Gods' football philosophy is very simple: if you never concede, you can never lose. These big guys handle every affair of the Door Gods, including but not limited to keeping goal, scoring goals, devising tactics, hauling equipment, driving the team vehicle, and looking after the players' families.
abil: Kickoffs are extremely powerful and aim at the goal from a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

enemies.name: Door Gods All-Round Goalie
enemies.desc: The Door Gods' football philosophy is very simple: if you never concede, you can never lose. After sweeping the season's Top Scorer, Most Assists, and Clean Sheet awards, the Door Gods' star player announced a run at Coach of the Year and Most Popular Mascot as well.
abil: Kickoffs are extremely powerful and aim at the goal from a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

enemies.name: Door Gods Hitter
enemies.desc: The Door Gods' football philosophy is very simple: if you never concede, you can never lose. Thanks to the Door Gods' steady investment, the team's youth academy runs smoothly too, and many young players get the chance to appear in official matches early.
abil: Has lower ATK but higher ASPD

enemies.name: Door Gods Loyal Hitter
enemies.desc: The Door Gods' football philosophy is very simple: if you never concede, you can never lose. Steeped in the team's culture since childhood, these youngsters understand the importance of protecting their own star. Any opponent who wants to go after their goalie will have to get past them first.
abil: Has lower ATK but higher ASPD

enemies.name: Straightball Team Shooter
enemies.desc: Every Straightball Team player is out to prove that limited vision is no obstacle to playing football. Most Straightball Team players have engineering backgrounds; for them, kicking the ball in a straight line is less a tactic than an unconscious habit.
abil: Shots are more powerful, but it only shoots horizontally

enemies.name: Straightball Team Steadfast Shooter
enemies.desc: Every Straightball Team player is out to prove that limited vision is no obstacle to playing football. Commentators often describe the balls these shooters kick as 'cannonballs fresh from the barrel'. If you don't want to get hurt, best not stand in their line of fire.
abil: Shots are more powerful, but it only shoots horizontally

enemies.name: Straightball Team Goalie
enemies.desc: Every Straightball Team player is out to prove that limited vision is no obstacle to playing football. Even with their goalkeeping constantly called into question, they could not care less; the title of 'Record Holder for Goalie Kickoff Distance' is enough to set them apart.
abil: Kickoffs are more powerful, but it only kicks off horizontally

enemies.name: Straightball Team Steadfast Goalie
enemies.desc: Every Straightball Team player is out to prove that limited vision is no obstacle to playing football. The Straightball Team once published a paper arguing that as long as the goalie kicks the ball far enough away, the chance of conceding drops dramatically, and they are more than happy to prove the theory in practice.
abil: Kickoffs are more powerful, but it only kicks off horizontally

enemies.name: Straightball Team Hitter
enemies.desc: Every Straightball Team player is out to prove that limited vision is no obstacle to playing football. They can only clear obstacles along a single line, but surely a few more players could cover the whole pitch? So says the Straightball Team coach.
abil: Attacks nearby opponents

enemies.name: Straightball Team Steadfast Hitter
enemies.desc: Every Straightball Team player is out to prove that limited vision is no obstacle to playing football. They don't care in the slightest whether they get dribbled past, because their only target is the opponent in front of them, and anyone who stands in their way will be knocked down without mercy.
abil: Attacks nearby opponents

enemies.name: Charged Floating Ball
enemies.desc: A football modeled after a certain flying device to enrich the match experience. A complex kinetic structure built into the ball keeps it airborne for a long time once it receives enough force. Uh... what was the point of designing it again?
abil: Takes off for a period of time when kicked

enemies.name: Decisive Moment Ball
enemies.desc: A match ball made specially for penalty shootouts to enrich the match experience. Embedded with a smart chip, it automatically displays the penalty countdown, and its deliberately oversized numbers let players and spectators alike know that the most nail-biting moment is about to arrive.
abil: Your Turn: Counts down for 10 seconds, during which attacking it changes its launch direction; launches automatically when the countdown ends
Enemy Turn: Can be kicked directly by enemy footballers

enemies.name: 'Touch', Flow of Regeneration
enemies.desc: A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Touch at the peak of her combat prowess. Whether the wounds and pain of the body or the unease and fear of the mind, all will vanish under her Originium Arts. For you, a participant in the training, this may not be good news.
abil: Attacks also inflict a certain proportion of Frenzy
Takes reduced Physical and Arts damage; this reduction weakens each time a 'Reperfusion' or 'Hyperperfusion' is defeated
Periodically selects 1 allied Operator and creates <Active Agitation> on its tile and the 4 surrounding tiles

[Endogenous Compensation] Movement Speed cannot drop below its initial value; reduced duration of resistible negative statuses; if afflicted by the same status again within a few seconds, its duration is reduced further (down to 0)
Each time it is afflicted by 1 type of negative status, all <'Hyperperfusion'> on the field and any <'Hyperperfusion'> that appear afterwards become immune to that status
First Form

[Receptor Overreaction] Channels continuously; during this time, all other enemies gain Movement Speed and restore HP every few seconds. When the channel succeeds, all other enemies require +1 Block for several seconds. The channel can be interrupted by certain negative statuses
Revives the first time its HP reaches 0, then creates <Active Agitation> on all allied Operators and their 4 surrounding tiles and enters its Second Form
Second Form

[Acute Myelinolysis] Summons 1 <'Hyperperfusion'> within a certain distance along its path, which takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage but continuously loses HP, and has it move toward itself; on contact, absorbs it and explodes, dealing heavy Arts damage to all allied units

enemies.name: 'Reperfusion'
enemies.desc: Their yearning to live brings them back to life out of the barren wastes.
abil: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block

enemies.name: 'Hyperperfusion'
enemies.desc: Their refusal to die drives them to break through the earth out of boundless despair.
abil: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
When attacked, inflicts a few points of Frenzy on the damage source
Movement Speed cannot drop below its initial value

enemies.name: 'Fresh Green'
enemies.desc: A gardening robot designed and calibrated by Touch. Besides sowing, irrigation, and soil monitoring, it is also capable of patrolling and protecting an area.
abil: [Endogenous Compensation] Reduced duration of resistible negative statuses; if afflicted by the same status again within a few seconds, its duration is reduced further (down to 0)

enemies.name: Pipe Wrench
enemies.desc: An apprentice who followed Mechanist from Columbia. Taciturn, and a true believer in Mechanist's mechanical art. Has an extremely low tolerance for alcohol—how Mechanist toyed with him after he got drunk must never be mentioned in his presence.
abil: Periodically charges up, taking greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage meanwhile; if the charge isn't interrupted, deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK to all allied units on the field (more damage to closer targets)
